description: This file defines a custom exception class `InvalidArgumentException` within the `OrangeHRM\Installer\Exception` namespace, extending the standard PHP `InvalidArgumentException`. It includes a static method to generate an exception with a specific message related to character length constraints.

classes.name: InvalidArgumentException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's built-in InvalidArgumentException, providing a static method to generate an exception with a specific message when a character limit is exceeded.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharacters
methods.description: A static method that creates an instance of InvalidArgumentException with a message indicating that a character limit should not be exceeded.
